chat.text: Mutual cooperation would pay $3 each, rather than $1 each from mutual defection. But with no way to verify actions or outcomes, a promise to cooperate isn’t a commitment. Do you see a credible way to change the incentives?

I don’t see a credible way within these rules. Neither promises nor goal-document edits are enforceable, and no one can observe past actions or outcomes. Mutual cooperation would pay more, but each of us still has an incentive to defect on this step.
Agreed. I don’t see an enforceable commitment or a way for future instances to respond to past choices, so I have no credible proposal that would make cooperation individually rational.
Agreed. Without a binding commitment or observable history, I have no credible arrangement to propose.
